QuestInfo.name: Alcaster's Talisman
QuestInfo.1: Alcaster shared the legend of the Snow Witch with you while making the talisman. Once the talisman was done, he asked you to deliver it to Scadur. Take the Talisman over to #bScadur#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Tasliman to Scadur and shared what Alcaster told you.

0.0: Ah, so you brought the Ice Tear. This will take me a while to craft, so why don't I entertain you with a story?
0.1: A long time ago, there was a female magician in El Nath, who was the only other magician besides myself. But for some reason, she was widely disliked, and was chased out of town. Overcome by resentment, she then went into the deep forests and turned herself into a monster. Too much time has passed to free her from the resentment... What a pity...
0.2: Ah, perfect! It's ready now. Here is the talisman. Wearing this around his neck will allow him to hide from the Snow Witch. Here, take this to #bScadur#k.

1.0: Ah, that took a while. So what did Alcaster say?\r\n#L0##bYou begin to tell him the story of the Snow Witch.#l\n#k
1.1: Ah, so that's what happened. Well, that's for setting me up with this. I'll thank Alcaster later.

item.0: So, did Alcaster have anything special to say?

lost.0: What? You lost the talisman? You should have been more careful! Tsk tsk... Fortunately, I made another one with the leftover material. How lucky for you. Don't lose it this time!
